class S2D4P.architectures.layers.conv.ConvNeXtBlock(in_channels: int, out_channels: int, config: ConvNeXtBlockConfig)

Bases: Module

Sequence of residual ConvNeXt stages.

The block optionally projects the input to the requested channel count before applying a sequence of ConvNeXt stages with progressively increasing stochastic-depth rates.

Parameters:

  • in_channels (int) – Number of channels entering the block.

  • out_channels (int) – Number of channels used by the ConvNeXt stages.

  • config (ConvNeXtBlockConfig) – Configuration defining projection and ConvNeXt stage behavior.

forward(input: TensorMask) → TensorMask

Apply channel projection and the configured ConvNeXt stages.

A projection is performed when input and output channel counts differ. Masks are propagated through partial convolutions when enabled.

Parameters:

input (TensorMask) – Input tensor and optional validity mask.

Returns:

Processed tensor and propagated validity mask.

Return type:

TensorMask

Convert convolutional features into latent distribution parameters.

A convolutional feature block is applied first, followed by a latent head that produces the latent mean and optional log-variance.

  • get_log_var (bool) – Whether to produce latent log-variance values in addition to the mean.

  • latent_normalization (NormalizationMethod | None) – Normalization applied before flattening latent features. If None, no latent normalization is applied.

S2D4P.architectures.layers.mlp.build_mlp(dims: list[int], *, activation: Literal['relu', 'gelu', 'silu'] = 'relu', dropout_rate: float | None = None, batch_normalization: bool = False, activate_final: bool = False) → Sequential

Build a multilayer perceptron from a sequence of layer dimensions.

Each consecutive pair of dimensions defines a linear layer. Hidden layers are followed by the configured activation and optional dropout and batch normalization. These operations are applied to the final layer only when activate_final is enabled.

Parameters:

  • dims (list[int]) – Sizes of the input, hidden, and output layers in order.

  • activation (ActivationName) – Activation function applied after applicable linear layers.

  • dropout_rate (float | None) – Dropout probability applied after activation. If None, dropout is disabled.

  • batch_normalization (bool) – Whether to apply one-dimensional batch normalization after applicable linear layers.

  • activate_final (bool) – Whether to apply activation, dropout, and batch normalization after the final linear layer.

Returns:

Sequential module containing the constructed multilayer perceptron.

Return type:

nn.Sequential

class S2D4P.architectures.layers.partialconv2d.PartialConv2d(*args, **kwargs)

Bases: Conv2d

Two-dimensional partial convolution with validity-mask propagation.

The convolution operates only on valid input values and rescales its output according to the number of valid values within each convolution window. Multi-channel masks and optional updated-mask output are supported.

Parameters:

  • args (Any) – Positional arguments passed to nn.Conv2d.

  • kwargs (Any) – Keyword arguments passed to nn.Conv2d. The additional multi_channel and return_mask arguments control mask handling.

forward(input, mask_in=None)

Apply partial convolution to an input tensor.

The input is optionally masked before convolution. The validity mask is convolved to determine the number of valid values in each receptive field, and the convolution output is rescaled accordingly.

Parameters:

  • input (torch.Tensor) – Four-dimensional input tensor with batch, channel, height, and width dimensions.

  • mask_in (torch.Tensor | None) – Optional validity mask associated with the input. If None, all input values are treated as valid.

Returns:

Partial-convolution output. When return_mask is enabled, the output and updated validity mask are returned as a tuple.

Return type:

torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]

Raises:

AssertionError – If input is not four-dimensional.

class S2D4P.architectures.layers.unet.DownBlock(in_channels: int, out_channels: int, *, block_config: ConvBlockConfig | PartialConvBlockConfig | ConvNeXtBlockConfig, mask_pooling: Literal['any', 'all', 'fraction'], mask_fraction_threshold: float, return_skip: bool = True, process_skip_connections: bool = False)

Bases: Module

Encode and downsample features within a U-Net.

The input is processed by a convolutional block before spatial downsampling. The pre-downsampling features can optionally be returned as a skip connection and processed by an additional convolutional block.

Parameters:

  • in_channels (int) – Number of channels entering the block.

  • out_channels (int) – Number of channels produced by downsampling.

  • block_config (ConvBlockConfig | PartialConvBlockConfig | ConvNeXtBlockConfig) – Configuration defining convolutional processing.

  • mask_pooling (MaskPoolingMethod) – Mask pooling method associated with downsampling.

  • mask_fraction_threshold (float) – Minimum valid fraction associated with fraction-based mask pooling.

  • return_skip (bool) – Whether to return pre-downsampling features as a skip connection.

  • process_skip_connections (bool) – Whether returned skip features are processed by an additional convolutional block.

forward(input: TensorMask) → TensorMask | tuple[TensorMask, TensorMask]

Partial convolution is used for downsampling when required by the block configuration, allowing the validity mask to be propagated.

input (TensorMask) – Input feature tensor and optional validity mask.

Returns:

Downsampled features, optionally together with the pre-downsampling skip features when return_skip is enabled.

TensorMask | tuple[TensorMask, TensorMask]

class S2D4P.architectures.layers.unet.UpBlock(input_channels: int, skip_channels: int | None, out_channels: int, *, block_config: ConvBlockConfig | PartialConvBlockConfig | ConvNeXtBlockConfig, upsampling_method: Literal['transpose_conv', 'bilinear', 'pixelshuffle'], skip_alignment_method: Literal['interpolation', 'padd', 'strict'], upsampling_kernel_size: int, inject_noise: bool = False, inject_noise_in_block: bool = False)

Bases: Module

Upsample and decode features within a U-Net.

Supports transposed convolution, bilinear interpolation, and pixel-shuffle upsampling. Upsampled features can be aligned and concatenated with a skip connection before convolutional processing.

Parameters:

  • input_channels (int) – Number of channels entering the upsampling block.

  • skip_channels (int | None) – Number of channels supplied by the skip connection. If None, no skip connection is required.

  • out_channels (int) – Number of channels produced by the block.

  • block_config (ConvBlockConfig | PartialConvBlockConfig | ConvNeXtBlockConfig) – Configuration defining post-upsampling convolutional processing.

  • upsampling_method (UpsamplingMethod) – Method used to increase spatial resolution.

  • skip_alignment_method (AlignmentMethod) – Method used to align upsampled features with skip features or a requested output shape.

  • upsampling_kernel_size (int) – Kernel size used by convolutional upsampling or channel projection.

  • inject_noise (bool) – Whether generator noise is injected during upsampling.

  • inject_noise_in_block (bool) – Whether noise injection is also enabled in the convolutional block after upsampling.

forward(input: TensorMask, skip: TensorMask | None = None, resize_shape: tuple | None = None) → TensorMask

Upsample and process a decoder feature tensor.

Optional generator noise is injected at a location determined by the upsampling method. When a skip connection is configured, the upsampled tensor is aligned with and concatenated to the skip tensor before convolutional processing.

Parameters:

  • input (TensorMask) – Input feature tensor and optional validity mask.

  • skip (TensorMask | None) – Optional encoder skip features.

  • resize_shape (tuple | None) – Spatial shape to which the upsampled tensor is aligned when no skip connection is configured.

Returns:

Upsampled and processed feature tensor.

Return type:

TensorMask

Raises:

ValueError – If a skip connection is configured but skip is not provided.

S2D4P.architectures.layers.unet.build_conv_block(in_channels: int, out_channels: int, config: ConvBlockConfig | PartialConvBlockConfig | ConvNeXtBlockConfig, *, latent_size: int = None, block_output_shape: tuple[int, int, int] | None = None, get_log_var: bool = True, latent_normalization: Literal['batch', 'group', 'layer', 'none'] | None = 'layar', inject_noise: bool = False) → Module

Build a configured convolutional block.

The block type is determined from config. Generator noise injection is configured on a copy of the supplied configuration. When latent_size is provided, the convolutional block is wrapped in a latent projection block.

Parameters:

  • in_channels (int) – Number of channels entering the convolutional block.

  • out_channels (int) – Number of channels produced by the convolutional block.

  • config (ConvBlockConfig | PartialConvBlockConfig | ConvNeXtBlockConfig) – Configuration defining the convolutional block type and behavior.

  • latent_size (int | None) – Size of the latent representation. If None, a standard convolutional block is returned.

  • block_output_shape (tuple[int, int, int] | None) – Output shape of the convolutional block used to construct the latent projection layer.

  • get_log_var (bool) – Whether a latent block produces log-variance values in addition to the latent mean.

  • latent_normalization (NormalizationMethod | None) – Normalization applied before latent projection.

  • inject_noise (bool) – Whether generator noise is injected within the convolutional block.

Returns:

Configured convolutional block or latent block.

Return type:

nn.Module

Raises:

  • TypeError – If config is not a supported convolutional block configuration.

  • ValueError – If latent projection is requested without block_output_shape or if the output shape channel count does not match out_channels.

S2D4P.architectures.layers.utils.align_to_skip(x: Tensor, skip_shape: Tensor, mode: Literal['interpolation', 'padd', 'strict'] = 'padd', padding_mode: Literal['zeros', 'reflect', 'replicate', 'circular'] = 'zeros') → Tensor

Align a tensor with a target spatial shape.

The tensor can be aligned by interpolation or padding, or strict shape matching can be enforced.

Parameters:

  • x (torch.Tensor) – Tensor whose spatial dimensions are aligned.

  • skip_shape (tuple[int, int]) – Target height and width.

  • mode (AlignmentMethod) – Method used to align the spatial dimensions.

  • padding_mode (PaddingMethod) – Padding mode used when mode is "padd".

Returns:

Tensor aligned to skip_shape.

Return type:

torch.Tensor

Raises:

  • RuntimeError – If strict alignment is requested and the spatial dimensions do not match.

  • ValueError – If mode is unsupported.

S2D4P.architectures.layers.utils.padd(x: Tensor, target_size: tuple[int, int], padding_mode: Literal['zeros', 'reflect', 'replicate', 'circular'] = 'zeros') → Tensor

Pad a tensor symmetrically to a target spatial size.

Any odd amount of required padding places the additional element on the right or bottom side.

Parameters:

  • x (torch.Tensor) – Tensor to pad.

  • target_size (tuple[int, int]) – Target height and width.

  • padding_mode (PaddingMethod) – Padding mode to apply. "zeros" uses constant zero padding.

Returns:

Tensor padded to the requested spatial size.

Return type:

torch.Tensor
